newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Mexican septuplets die of lung failure.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexican septuplets die of lung failure.

text.p: Two Mexican septuplets died of lung failure on Friday four days after birth, a hospital spokesman said.

The baby girls, the last two to be born, could not be saved because of complications from their premature birth, the hospital said. They weighed only 17.5 ounces (500 grams) and 21.7 ounces (620 grams).
The remaining five babies, three girls and two boys, are in grave condition because of their underdeveloped lungs, doctors said.
The septuplets were born 12 weeks premature to Maria Rocio Diaz Carrillo, 28, who had been taking fertility medicine.
